title: Branch state
description: Branch-specific workflow state stored at <git-dir>/oakshelf/development/<branch-safe-id>.json. Only the branch-state tool writes this file.

intent.description: The normalized intent. Null until the development-intent skill produces it.

intentHash.description: Hash of the canonical intent text. Null until the intent is locked.

intentSize.description: Size estimate of the approved intent scope. Set with the intent and applied to the PR as a size label.

intentApprovedAt.description: Set by the branch-state tool when the intent is locked.

lastReviewedHead.description: The commit the last passing review evaluated. Review is stale when HEAD differs.

lastReviewStatus.description: Result of the last review, valid only for lastReviewedHead.

pullRequest.description: The PR number for this branch, when one exists.
